in_sanskrit.name: वानर्सी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Banarsi is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘वानर्’ (vanar) and ‘सी’ (si). ‘वानर्’ (vanar) is a word used to describe a monkey or a merchant in ancient Indian texts. The term ‘सी’ (si) is used as a suffix to denote the profession or identity of an individual. Hence, the name Banarsi literally means ‘merchant’ or ‘trader’ in Sanskrit.

in_hindi.meaning: वानर् (vanar) + सी (si) = वानरसी (vanrasi) = व्यवसायी (vyavasayi) = businessman, merchant
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Banarsi in Hindi is written as ‘वानरसी’ (vanrasi). The word ‘वानर्’ (vanar) is derived from the Sanskrit language and means a monkey or a merchant. The term ‘सी’ (si) is used as a suffix to denote the profession or identity of an individual. Therefore, the name Banarsi in Hindi translates to ‘businessman’ or ‘merchant’.
